runtimeTargets.label: Node
runtimeTargets.summary: Explicit Native and generally available JavaScript execution over one canonical application contract.

runtimeTargets.label: Fastly Compute
runtimeTargets.summary: Explicit Native direct-host-ABI Wasm and generally available JavaScript source/deployment candidates.

runtimeTargets.label: Compile only
runtimeTargets.summary: Compilation and inspection without a runnable provider target.

canonical-application.label: Canonical application surface
canonical-application.promise: Fully documented and supported as the Pulse application authoring or workflow contract.

supported-extension.label: Supported provider/extension surface
supported-extension.promise: Documented entry points are supported; implementation and toolchain subpaths are explicitly excluded.

implementation.label: Implementation/transitive surface
implementation.promise: Installable as part of the synchronized release set, without an application-author compatibility guarantee.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/runtime
packages.audience: Pulse application authors and library authors who type portable handlers and static routers.
packages.directInstall: Yes. Install it in every Pulse application.
packages.stability: Supported application authoring and execution contract.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/pulse
packages.audience: Pulse application authors using the conventional project root, configuration factory, and schema declarations.
packages.directInstall: Yes. Install it in every conventional Pulse project.
packages.stability: Supported conventional application, project-configuration, and schema-authoring contract.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/cli
packages.audience: Pulse application authors, CI workflows, and tooling integrations.
packages.directInstall: Yes. Install the package globally or as a project development dependency.
packages.stability: Supported Beta workflow and project-configuration contract.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/provider-fastly
packages.audience: Applications targeting Fastly Compute and Pulse provider maintainers.
packages.directInstall: Yes, for Fastly projects. Node-only projects do not need to import it directly.
packages.stability: The listed entry points are supported for the Beta; all other exported subpaths are implementation-only.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/grip
packages.audience: Applications using stateless GRIP/Fanout HTTP framing and request-bound broadcast behavior.
packages.directInstall: Yes, only when the application uses GRIP/Fanout behavior.
packages.stability: The package root has bounded JavaScript and Native HTTP-framing realization plus configured Node/Fastly broadcast; /pulsewasm remains compatibility-only.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/assets
packages.audience: Applications using JavaScript asset middleware or the package-owned lowerable asset lookup capability.
packages.directInstall: Yes, only when the application uses the assets capability.
packages.stability: The package root is the supported JavaScript API and canonical Native authoring surface; /pulsewasm remains a compatibility subpath, while manifest/compiler subpaths are toolchain integration.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/crypto
packages.audience: Applications and first-party packages using provider-neutral verification and exact-text SHA-256.
packages.directInstall: Yes, when an application uses verification or digestText directly; JWT applications receive it transitively.
packages.stability: The package root supports bounded verification and request-owned exact-text digests; provider, manifest/compiler and Native integration subpaths remain toolchain-only.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/jwt
packages.audience: Applications verifying JWT credentials and issuing bounded HS256 worker tokens through Pulse providers.
packages.directInstall: Yes, when an application verifies or signs JWTs.
packages.stability: The package root supports provider-neutral verification and bounded HS256 signing; provider and compiler integration subpaths are not application APIs.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/entities
packages.audience: Applications declaring bounded schema-backed entity operations through the first-party JSON-RPC adapter.
packages.directInstall: Yes, when an application declares entity operations.
packages.stability: The package root and first-party JSON-RPC adapter are supported Beta contracts; compiler integration subpaths remain toolchain-only.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/s3
packages.audience: Applications using bounded exact-key object reads and writes through Pulse effects.
packages.directInstall: Yes, when an application uses S3 object operations.
packages.stability: The package root supports head, getText and putText on Node Native, Node JavaScript and Fastly Native. Fastly JavaScript is ineligible. Provider and lowering subpaths are toolchain-only; live origin acceptance is separate.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-build-support
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; it is installed transitively where required.
packages.stability: Internal release-set interface; exported modules may change with compiler implementation needs.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-compiler
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; use the pulse CLI.
packages.stability: Internal compiler interface; no application-author compatibility guarantee.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-guest-link
packages.audience: Pulse compiler, release, and first-party guest-unit maintainers.
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; it is an internal synchronized compiler dependency.
packages.stability: Internal first-party prebuilt guest-link interface synchronized with the compiler; no application-author or third-party guest compatibility guarantee.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-contracts
packages.audience: Pulse compiler, runtime, provider, and package-lowering maintainers.
packages.directInstall: Provider toolchain authors may install it for the versioned bootstrap contract; application projects receive it transitively.
packages.stability: The provider toolchain contract is versioned and supported for the Beta; other protocol and proof interfaces remain internal.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-host-runtime
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; it is installed transitively.
packages.stability: Internal compiler/runtime interface synchronized with this release set.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-library-kit
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; it is installed transitively.
packages.stability: Internal package-lowering interface synchronized with this release set.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/provider-node
packages.audience: Pulse canonical Node provider and compiler maintainers.
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; select provider: node through the CLI.
packages.stability: The listed built-in toolchain entry is synchronized with the Beta bootstrap contract; other canonical Node provider interfaces remain internal.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-runtime-core-as
packages.audience: Pulse AssemblyScript runtime-core and compiler maintainers.
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; it is installed transitively.
packages.stability: Internal code-generation interface synchronized with this release set.

packages.name: @pulse-compute/wasm-schema-json
packages.audience: Pulse schema compiler and runtime maintainers.
packages.directInstall: No for application projects; declare schemas in the selected .pulse/config.ts profile.
packages.stability: Internal schema compiler interface synchronized with this release set.
packages.replacement: schemas in .pulse/config.ts through the Pulse project workflow
